Now is the time to transform your health & wellbeing

Whether you want to reverse or prevent serious health conditions or reset, reboot, and rebalance your body, mind, and spirit, the globally-renowned Hippocrates Wellness Life Transformation Program is the ultimate experience to transform your mental and physical wellbeing at any stage of life. Located in West Palm Beach, Our 21-day transformative program is home to a qualified team of experts offering decades of experience in nutrition, integrative health, and holistic and Western medicine. Together, we manage scientifically-supported and highly personalized programs and protocols to help people to heal themselves. Transform with our ground-breaking lectures, one-to-one consultations, comprehensive testing, health data analysis, advanced doctors and certified therapists, organic enzyme-rich, plant-based cuisine, and state-of-the-art technology. Vida

Hippocrates' pioneering team of experts at Vida is integral to your wellness journey. Our experienced nurses, leading nutritionists, exceptional MD, and other specialists will guide you from the moment your transformative journey begins and throughout your stay.

FITNESS SUITE

Housed within the Hippocrates Wellness facility is our state-of-the-art fitness center providing all the equipment you need to exercise independently or with one of our highly-qualified personal trainers. Our eclectic group fitness classes include yoga, Qigong, functional fitness, aquafit, and more to ensure a well-rounded approach so you can look and feel your best.

REGENERATION POOLS

We provide a number of pools across our 55-acre campus, including hot and cold plunge pools to aid relaxation and detoxification. Alternating between these can help control joint inflammation, enhance muscle recovery, and improve circulation.

Educate, inspire, and transform yourself in 21 days

Hippocrates Wellness is the world-leading wellness center offering the only lifestyle and dietary program clinically researched for over 70 years. Hippocrates implements four advanced protocols – Immunity, Regeneration, Fitness, and Mindfulness to educate and inspire countless lives to wellbeing and longevity. Transformation in a safe healing environment

Balance is essential to wellness. At Hippocrates Wellness, you can trust that we put your wellbeing and that of the planet first on our chemical-free, 55-acre, tranquil walking campus. Help your body to heal itself with our signature organic, enzyme-rich, plant-based cuisine, including homegrown green juices and our self-serve Wheatgrass Bar to combat inflammation, premature aging, and chronic diseases. Avoid harmful toxins with our organic, eco-friendly beauty products, 100% organic cotton towels and synthetic-free bedding, purifying water filter system, and chlorine-free regenerating pools to rebalance and re-energize your whole body. You can relax and detoxify with our Far Infrared Saunas, immerse yourself in nature and self-care on our on-campus walking trails and mindful Meditation Labyrinth, reboot your body and mind with our fitness classes and educational lectures, and explore the stunning, tropical grounds on a free-to-hire push bike. Whatever your health goals, Hippocrates Wellness will guide you toward emotional, physical, and spiritual wellbeing so you can feel and be your best self.

Meet a selection of our talented & inspired team of health care professionals

Hippocrates Wellness is home to a team of leading experts with decades of collective experience in nutrition, integrative health, and holistic and western medicine. Together, we manage supportive and highly personalized programs and protocols for all guests on our tropical West Palm Beach campus. From ground-breaking lectures and one-on-one consultations to blood panel and test analysis, our world-class professionals are fully dedicated to your personal wellness journey.

Dr. Joshua Helman, MD

Chief Medical Officer

Dr. Joshua Helman, MD is an Emergency Medicine physician licensed in fourteen states. “Dr. Josh” has two degrees in biochemistry, (bachelor’s from Harvard magna cum laude and master’s from the University of Cambridge, UK). His dual medical degree is from Harvard Medical School and MIT and he is board-certified by both the American Board of Emergency Medicine and the American Board of Lifestyle Medicine. His areas of interest include vitality, longevity, toxins, exosomes, biofilm, chronic neurologic diseases, mold, Lyme disease and fasting. He is passionate about applying his biochemical knowledge to real-world challenges. As a plant-based physician, he embraces an integrative approach including the importance of diet and lifestyle for optimal health.

Brian Clement Ph.D., L.N.

Co-Director

Brian Clement, Ph.D., L.N., has spearheaded the international progressive health movement for over five decades. He is the Director of the globally renowned Hippocrates Wellness, West Palm Beach, Florida, the world's foremost complementary residential health center. Over the last half-century, he and his team have pioneered clinical research and training in disease prevention using hundreds of thousands of participants who provided volumes of data, giving Clement a privileged insight into the lifestyle required to avert disease, enhance longevity, and maintain vitality. Their findings have provided the basis for Hippocrates' progressive, state-of-the-art treatments and protocols for health maintenance and recovery – the Life Transformation Program.

Andy Roman, MS, LMHC, RN

Psychotherapist

Andy has served as a mind/body psychotherapist at Hippocrates Wellness since December of 1990, using and teaching radical feeling-centered, body-focused awareness tools to help Hippocrates' guests discover the essence of their problems and arrive at solutions. He facilitates the ongoing Healing Circle therapy and support group on campus and created S.H.I.F.T (State of the Heart Integrative Feeling Therapy), simultaneously centering on body awareness, here-and-now encounters, cognitive coherence, and emotional charge.

Amazing place to recover balance into life and lead valuable tools to heal from within..

I was there with my son, who was diagnosed with a brain tumour and couldn’t get up from bed when we arrived there, he had bad habits of eating junks and not exercising.

After 4 weeks at Hippocrates riding his bike, happier, more energised and understanding the values of healthy habits toward his recovery as going through an operation is not an option anymore!

Thank you Brian, Anna-Maria and team for everything that you do!

2 years ago
I would highly recommend a stay here!! My stay was amazing and the person who went out of her way to make it so was Tedina Bodder!! Thank you Tedina, for trying so hard!! Thank you for rearranging schedules for endless hours so you could make my stay better!! I am not sure if my experience would be as nice if it was not for Tedina!!
Thank you Tedina Bodder for taking care of our whole group and making sure we had everything we needed!
ROI STRATEGIES

I don’t understand why the tongs are placed in the bowl on top of the food????? They should have tong holders next to every bowl to place back down it’s disgusting peoples dirty hands touch the tongs and then place them back on top of the food???? Your a multi-million dollar facility, get another table to space out room for the tong holders and buy them!!!!! That is absolutely disgusting and for a health and wellness center you should know better. Only respond to my review once you’ve gone ahead and implemented this change so I can come back and actually sit down for lunch and remove my review. I have autoimmune disorder and lymphatic cancer. I can’t afford to get sick with Covid, measles and candida going around!!!!!!!! This is basic stuff and should be an easy fix within 1 week!!!!

2 years ago
It as if I died and went to heaven… spent 3 weeks in paradise, surrounded by unconditional love and vitality in its purest form… and then… after 3 weeks, God sent me back home to earth.
chris ryman
2 years ago
Excellent medical facilities. Helpful staff. Adrian helped me with a live time experience. Josh was great and the lectures were informative. The psychologist and psychiatrist were helpful. The rooms were very clean and spacious
jelani de leon
2 years ago
HHI has thought of every detail to ensure their guests have a top notch experience; all while attending to their well being. That’s impressive in my opinion. Other places may do one or the other. Hippocrates has figured out how to do both. On top of that the staff are nice people. I was always greeted with a smile or a hello from the grounds keepers to the directors themselves.
Taking care of self while feeling pampered to me is the best vacation I can have. It’s not going to be affordable for everyone but for those who can swing it, it’s money well spent. The food is wholesome and clean so you can indulge guilt free and still lose weight. The grounds are beautifully tended. The hot/cold plunge pools are so therapeutic. There are saunas throughout the campus which make detoxification easy. The fitness area is quite ample for a good daily workout. The exercise classes are great!!! I loved the Nuro-size classes that work on your brain.👏🏽🙌🏽
They really have thought of everything and made it easy indulge in wellness.
Tom O'Ryan
2 years ago
Hippocrates Wellness is hands-down unlike any other place. If you're serious about taking control of your health and want access to top experts, cutting-edge facilities, and transformative programs, this is where you need to be. I just wrapped up their 21-day Life Transformation Program, and it was a game-changer for me. The whole experience—from the raw, plant-based food to the advanced therapies—helped me feel better than I have in years. The lectures, fitness sessions, and time with the specialists gave me solid, practical insights I could actually use in daily life. The staff were incredibly supportive and made sure I felt right at home on their beautiful campus. I left feeling recharged, sharper, and more connected to my health. Can’t recommend it enough for anyone ready to step up their wellness game.
